synopsis: Pam Ayres celebrates 30 years in show business with her one woman show which was recorded live at the Everyman Theatre in Cheltenham. Featuring a mix of new and classic poems and monologues, Pam's unique style has made her a firm favourite with audiences both in the UK and throughout the world.
